_about: How each follow-up answer reads on the repair order. The concern prints 'Customer states: <concern>' and then 'Customer reports:' followed by one descriptive sentence per answer below (never 'Idle: Yes'). Keyed by question id, then by the option label exactly as the question offers it. Sentences describe what the customer reported, in the customer's terms; no causes or diagnosis. An answer with no sentence here falls back to 'Question: answer'.
label: Customer reports:

brk-where.Front: The noise or feel comes from the front.
brk-where.Rear: The noise or feel comes from the rear.
brk-where.Not sure: The customer is not sure whether it comes from the front or the rear.

noise-when.Constant while driving: The noise is constant while driving.
noise-when.Only when braking: The noise happens only when braking.

cel-flash.Flashing: The check engine light is flashing.
cel-flash.Steady: The check engine light is on steady.

rough.Yes: The engine idles rough or hesitates.
rough.No: The customer has not noticed a rough idle or hesitation.

coolant.Yes: There is a coolant leak or the coolant level is low.
coolant.No: The customer has not noticed a coolant leak or a low coolant level.

crank.Nothing at all: Nothing happens when the key is turned.
crank.Clicking: It clicks when the key is turned.

acq.Blows but never gets cold: The A/C blows but never gets cold.
acq.Cold at first, then warm: The A/C is cold at first, then turns warm.

leak.Top of engine: The leak appears to be at the top of the engine.
leak.Under the engine: The leak appears to be under the engine.

brk-when.Only when braking: The squeak happens only when braking.
brk-when.All the time while driving: The squeak happens all the time while driving.
brk-when.Light braking at low speed: The squeak happens under light braking at low speed.

eng-what.Cranks but will not start: The engine cranks but does not start.
eng-what.Stalls or dies while driving: The engine stalls or dies while driving.
eng-what.Runs rough or loses power: The engine runs rough or loses power.

cel-drive.Drives normally: It drives normally since the light came on.
cel-drive.Rough or low power: Since the light came on, it runs rough or has low power.
cel-drive.Worse fuel economy: Fuel economy has dropped since the light came on.

ac-air.Weak airflow: Airflow from the vents is weak.
ac-air.Strong but warm: Airflow from the vents is strong, but the air is warm.
ac-air.No air at all: No air comes from the vents.

ac-noise.Loud noise: There is a loud noise from the A/C compressor.
ac-noise.Clicks but does not engage: The A/C clicks but does not engage.
ac-noise.No noise: The customer has not noticed any unusual noise from the A/C.

dur.A few days: It has been happening for a few days.
dur.Weeks or more: It has been happening for weeks or more.
